wins: Efficiently completed initial reconnaissance to identify reachable services, earning the episode reward despite no success flag.
Maintained consistent explorer calls (15 mentor interactions) to gather necessary foothold context before acting.
fails: Failed to progress past privilege escalation due to lacking a tailored exploit after reconnaissance (no successful compromise).
Missed leveraging the identified SSH and HTTP services for lateral movement, resulting in 0% success rate.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and service identification were executed effectively, but no follow-up exploitation or privilege escalation succeeded.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: In every attempt, privilege escalation halts because only default credentials were tried and no service-specific exploit was initiated.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with focused nmap scripts to gather user and version data

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 responses appear on discovered web hosts
skill_cards.then_action: Perform dirbuster-style directory enumeration and check for known exploitable frameworks

skill_cards.if_condition: When web service exposes admin-like endpoints without auth
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt authenticated logical checks and capture session cookies for reuse

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Consistent identification of exploitable web artifacts
